'''Making ''ter'angreal''''' is a [[Talent]] regarding the ability to create a ''[[ter'angreal]]''. While this ability has been lost to the [[White Tower]] for some time, some [[Seanchan]] ''[[damane]]'' are valued for their ability to create ''[[a'dam]]''.

This ability allows a person to both create a completely new ''ter'angreal'' or to copy one which already exists. Examples of the latter would include a number of [[Sleepweaver]]s formerly in the possession of the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]], ''a'dam'', and the [[Seanchan]] replications of the [[Domination Band]]. Copies of the Sleepweavers are not as effective as the real one for when the user is in ''Tel'aran'rhiod'' they seem transparent. An improvement made in the ''a'dam'' shows that the collar and bracelet can work without the leash.
